bioconda.name: openadmixture
bioconda.summary: ADMIXTURE-compatible ancestry estimation in Julia, with a native Apple Silicon build
bioconda.description:
OpenADMIXTURE estimates individual ancestry proportions (Q) and population allele
frequencies (P) from PLINK .bed files, with the same model and command-line
interface as ADMIXTURE 1.3 (-j, -s, -C, --cv, -B). This package bundles its own
Julia runtime and precompiled dependencies, so it runs offline.
